newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: FPHC led group vies for Manila power deal.
newsitem.headline: FPHC led group vies for Manila power deal.

text.p: A consortium led by First Private Power Corp (FPPC) said on Monday it has submitted a bid for the rehabilitation and operation of a 650-megawatt hydro-electric project in Laguna, south of Manila.

In a press statement, FPPC chief operating officer Ernesto Pantangco said his was the only group which submitted a bid for the Caliraya-Botocan-Kalayaan project prior to a November 27 deadline set by the National Power Corporation.
FPPC is a unit of First Philippine Holdings Corp.
Members of the FPPC consortium are Snowy Mountains Engineering of Australia, Sulzer Hydro of Switzerland, Siemens AG, and Philipp Holzman AG.
Pantangco said Snowy Mountains will act as overall project manager as well as the operations and maintenance contractor.
The National Power Corporation invited bids for the project on receiving an unsolicited bid from Argentine firm Industries Mettalurgica Pescarmona Sociedad Anonimas (Impsa).
Under Philippine law, state projects for which an unsolicited bid may have been received have to be opened for public bidding.
